For a long time we hadn't put any publication for our formalization. but we've finally posted a technical report on arXiv.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13780
Mechanizing Gödel's incompleteness Theorems and Provability Logic

We mechanized proof of Gödel's first and second incompleteness theorems, Solovay's arithmetical completeness theorem of GL, and related results in the Lean 4 theorem prover.

We've written a lot in the future works section about what we'd like to do going forward in FFL, so please take a look if you're interested!
